zoe (Docs): opening a tiny PR to clarify batching vs kv-prefetch on the Optimize Toolkit page. found a dead example link and vague wording about memory tradeoffs.
ravi (Eng): please show concrete numbers in snippets. prefer prefetch_window=32 as default example and mention we skip prefetch for prefixes <8 tokens.
hana (ML): add a quant note: "When prefix caching matters prefer 8-bit/mixed precision; validate any 4-bit setting with the eval harness." include a link to the eval guide.
omar (DevEx): include both python and Go short snippets and a one-line debug tip to grep for "prefetch_applied=true" in client logs.
linkbot: link-check queued for PR #5510 on merge.
jade (QA): i'll run a perf toggle script if you add one in examples/optkit/perf; tag me and i'll paste median latencies.
zoe (Docs): plan in PR description: 1) fix dead link 2) insert py+go snippets showing prefetch_window=32 3) call out short-prefix threshold (<8) and mem tradeoffs 4) swap vague quant wording for explicit recommendation + eval link 5) add minimal perf script in examples and tag QA. will request review from ravi/hana/omar/jade. :rocket:
